newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: City Developments hits new year high.
newsitem.headline: City Developments hits new year high.

text.p: Singapore property bluechip City Developments Ltd (CDL) hit a new year high of Singapore $14.30 in active trade on Monday.
Dealers said funds were buying on renewed optimism over the property outlook for Singapore.
At 0230 GMT, the stock was hovering at S$14.20, up S$0.70, with over 1.02 million shares changing hands.
Dealers said there was a block trade of 400,590 shares changing hands at between S$13.378 and S$13.418, well below the market price.
"All the property counters are running this morning. It is mainly funds buying," said a dealer with a local brokerage.
She said the buying was probably sparked by property tycoon Ng Teng Fong's aggressive bidding of some government sites at a land sale last week.
